# `figure`

Rows of character art with named regions, drawn by the `figure` widget (12 §10.3).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `rows` (list of string; **required**): The drawing: one string per row, one character per cell.
- `map` (list of string; optional): Which region each cell belongs to: rows of the same shape as `rows`, each character a key of `regions` or a space for none.
- `regions` (object, name → string; optional): The name of the region each character of `map` stands for.
